draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.37, the 31st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 2nd of 12 at TE. He lasted until pick 101, well after his grade rank (31st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: David Njoku. Testing concerns: vertical jump (9th percentile), broad jump (16th percentile). College production: his final season (2023) ranked 2nd in receiving yards among the 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Carolina Panthers. 29 career games and 13 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: catch rate 85.3% (98th percentile). Weak spots: yards per target 5.6 (7th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 tight end who played: 190 receiving yards against a median of 128, above the norm.
